concept: Just because we believe something doesn't automatically make it true — checking our thinking
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short scenario where a character is sure of something (e.g. a rumor) and discovers it wasn't quite true after checking
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did the character find out they were wrong? How did that feel?
exercise.practice: Student plays a simple 'true or not sure' sorting game with statements

assessment.success_marker: student can explain the difference between 'I think' and 'I checked and know'
